title: The Emperor's Secret
story_idea: A court archivist discovers that the emperor's death was staged and must decide whether to reveal him before the palace guards reach her.

character_bible.name: Lin Yue (林月)
character_bible.role: Palace archivist who protects the imperial records
character_bible.appearance: Slender build, upright posture, warm ivory skin
character_bible.facial_features: Oval face, straight dark brows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, a small beauty mark below the left eye
character_bible.hairstyle: Black hair in a low braided bun, center part, one narrow jade hairpin
character_bible.costume: Deep teal cross-collar silk hanfu with narrow sleeves and subtle cloud embroidery; same costume in every scene
character_bible.accessories: Narrow pale-jade hairpin and a small dark leather document pouch at the waist
character_bible.personality_visual_impression: Alert, restrained, intelligent; fear shown through small controlled movements

script.action_zh: 深夜，林月在藏书阁翻开先帝遗诏，发现纸背藏着一枚新鲜的朱印。
script.narration_zh: 皇帝驾崩第三夜，遗诏竟有新印。
script.narration_en: Three nights after his death, the emperor's decree bears a fresh seal.

script.action_zh: 门外甲胄声逼近。林月把诏书靠近烛火，一条隐藏的龙纹缓缓浮现。
script.narration_zh: 脚步逼近，龙纹在火光中显形。
script.narration_en: As guards approach, Lin Yue uncovers a hidden dragon mark.

script.action_zh: 暗门从书架后开启。林月藏起诏书，逆光里一个戴着玉佩的身影抬起头。
script.narration_zh: 暗门之后，死去的皇帝现身。
script.narration_en: A secret door opens, and the dead emperor appears.
